description:
You are an Industrial Engineer at an automotive components manufacturer. You have just completed a lean manufacturing assessment on the brake pad production line and need to document both the current state and the proposed future state using Value Stream Mapping (VSM) in Wondershare EdrawMax. Create a 2-page VSM document as follows:

Page 1 — Current State VSM: Map the full current-state value stream for brake pad production. The map must include: (1) a Supplier icon (upstream) and a Customer icon (downstream); (2) a Production Control / Planning box in the center top with information flow arrows (zigzag lightning-bolt arrows) going to the supplier and to each process step; (3) at least four production process boxes in sequence (e.g., Raw Material Stamping, Welding, Surface Treatment, Final Assembly & QC), each with a data box below it showing process metrics (Cycle Time, Changeover Time, Uptime, Operators); (4) inventory triangles (push triangles) between every pair of adjacent process boxes showing inventory accumulation; (5) push arrows between process steps indicating push production; (6) a timeline bar at the bottom showing value-added time and non-value-added (lead time) segments for each process step and each inventory point. Use VSM-specific shapes from EdrawMax's Lean Mapping or Value Stream Map shape library.

Page 2 — Future State VSM: Draw the improved future-state map showing the lean improvements (e.g., implementing pull/kanban between some steps, eliminating waste, reducing inventory, combining steps). Highlight the changes with kaizen burst shapes and include a summary box listing the top 3 improvements and their expected impact on lead time and cycle time.

Apply a professional theme. Save the completed diagram as '/home/ga/vsm_current_future.eddx'.
